description: Labeled retrieval benchmark for the Quran assistant. Each item has a natural-language question and a set of gold verse_ids (well-known primary references on the topic). A retrieval is counted correct when a gold verse appears in the returned top-k. Gold sets are intentionally non-exhaustive: they list canonical, widely-cited verses for the topic, which is the right target for a precision/recall proxy. Extend freely — more items = a more reliable signal.
